append.detail: Built 2026-11-16 over the tables on main: lib/hunts/route-health.ts buildRouteHealth gives the organiser (any Hunt role, decide read_aggregate through authorizeHuntAction) runs started, playing, finished and not started; per stop the runs that reached it, wait after it and have stalled 24 hours or more; use of each alternate placement of a stop; open and closed placements and the open ones marked damaged, missing or unchecked; each active venue's own counts; and the Hunt outbox as message status. No run id or timestamp survives the model. partnerRouteView is what a venue gets (shown on its venue report): its own placements and confirmed stops exactly, nothing about another venue, and every Trail-wide number through the FH-026 small-cell rule (hidden under 5, then steps of 5). Proof: lib/hunts/route-health.test.ts holds every other player still and moves one player along six different onward paths; the venue's view is identical in all six, while the organiser's differs. At a multiple of five a change shows as one whole step and is the same whoever moved. Page: /hunts/<slug>/health, kit Focus shell, dark behind HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED. No migration. Not read yet, and filed as FH-032S: FH-029 live partner state (the seam is activeVenues) and an FH-031 finale broadcast (there is none on main; the outbox stands in).
